imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures of every active site at zoom 19; visible station building, adjacent parking and on-site apron/circulation were estimated against the displayed map scale.

roads.assessment: Packaged road/service-drive centerlines were inspected alongside imagery. Modeled spawns are snapped to selected local road centerlines as simulation starts; they do not verify driveway ownership, gates or apparatus entrances.

limits: Rectangle centers, dimensions, rotations and spawn coordinates are imagery- and road-map-based estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No official station parcel plans, building footprints or apparatus entrance locations were used.
Satellite imagery dates are not supplied by the tile response.
Canonical source coordinates, base IDs and statuses are preserved.

bases.name: Pickering Paramedic Station
bases.imageryObservation: The zoom-19 image was reviewed for Pickering Paramedic Station: fitted footprint covers the visible station building and associated parking/apron/circulation at this site. Source point is preserved. Spawn is a modeled point on the mapped service centerline (service), not a confirmed entrance.
bases.rotationBasis: Axis-aligned estimate follows the visible local parcel and street grid; not survey-derived.
